### **1. Cercli**


Orin


, Cercli’s AI sourcing agent, covers what Juicebox is known for, plain-language people search. It works on its own or alongside your existing ATS. Describe the person you need, in writing or by voice, and Orin searches the live public market. Every candidate comes back ranked on experience and scope, with the reasoning shown. Orin also connects to Claude through MCP. Start a search in Orin and pick it up in Claude, or the other way around. Criteria and shortlist carry over. You send outreach by LinkedIn or email with no messaging caps. Orin never contacts a candidate without you. Orin also works standalone, with a


[free trial](https://app.cercli.com/orin/signup) .


[Cera](https://www.cercli.com/cera/) , the AI screening agent in Cercli’s ATS, reads every application and scores it against your criteria. Each candidate gets a summary of strengths and gaps. Cera recommends, and recruiters decide who advances.


Inside the ATS, you can let candidates book their own interviews and send offers for e-signature from the candidate profile.


#### **Pros**


- You can override any score or ranking.


- Both agents log their work.


- Reusable interview kits tell every interviewer what to ask.


#### **Cons**


- ATS pricing is by quote, shared before you commit.


- No recorded video interviewing.


#### **Best for:**


SMB hiring teams that want sourcing and an ATS in one tool.


### **2. Gem**


Gem pairs its own ATS with AI agents for sourcing and past-candidate rediscovery, and it can run on top of Greenhouse or Workday.


#### **Pros**


- Email-finding is unlimited, so you won’t ration contact credits.


- Teams under 30 employees get six months free, then 50% off.


#### **Cons**


- Pricing above 100 employees is custom, so larger teams need a sales call.


- The AI agents need AI-Powered seats.


#### **Best for:**


Growing teams that want past-candidate rediscovery next to an ATS.


### **3. SeekOut**


SeekOut replaces your sourcing tool and surfaces security clearances and diversity indicators in search. It works with your ATS on custom plans.


#### **Pros**


- Recruit Core is $149 per user per month, billed annually, with a 14-day trial.


- It includes outreach sequences and 500 contact credits a month.


#### **Cons**


- Diversity filters and ATS integration need a custom plan.


- It has no ATS, so interviews and offers happen elsewhere.


#### **Best for:**


Sourcing-heavy teams that need clearance and diversity filters.


### **4. hireEZ**


hireEZ targets mid-market and enterprise teams. Its EZ Agent sources candidates from the open web and screens applicants on top of your ATS.


#### **Pros**


- The same agent also schedules interviews.


- Campaigns run over email and text messages.


#### **Cons**


- Solo recruiters start at $494 per user per month, billed annually.


- Team pricing is set after a four-week verification period.


#### **Best for:**


Teams on Workday or SAP SuccessFactors that need open-web passive sourcing.


### **5. Pin**


Pin works a lot like Juicebox, with an AI Recruiting Agent that searches and scores candidates.


#### **Pros**


- There’s a free plan with 5 contact credits a week.


- Professional is $135 per user per month, billed annually.


#### **Cons**


- ATS integration is a paid add-on below Enterprise.


- The Solo plan, $100 per user per month, is billed annually only.


#### **Best for:**


Independent recruiters and small agencies starting free.


### **6. LinkedIn Recruiter**


LinkedIn Recruiter searches LinkedIn’s own network. Its Hiring Assistant agent is a paid add-on for Recruiter Corporate and Recruiter Professional Services Plus contracts.


#### **Pros**


- You can message candidates through InMail.


- Recruiter System Connect syncs your activity into your ATS on every plan above Recruiter Lite.


#### **Cons**


- InMail is capped at 150 a month on Corporate and 30 on Lite.


- Only Recruiter Lite has a listed price, about $170 a month.


#### **Best for:**


Teams filling hard-to-find roles by sourcing on LinkedIn’s network.


### **7. Ashby**


Ashby centers on structured hiring, and its AI mostly searches candidates already in your database.


#### **Pros**


- Foundations pricing for up to 100 employees follows company size, so extra recruiters add no cost.


- Interview scheduling and offers with e-signature are included.


#### **Cons**


- No external talent database is listed, so you’ll likely need a sourcing tool.


- Extra email lookups are a paid add-on with no listed price.


#### **Best for:**


Startups looking for sourcing and scheduling inside one ATS.


### **8. Workable**


Workable is an ATS and HR suite with credit-based AI agents. They source passive candidates and screen applicants against up to 14 criteria.


#### **Pros**


- Plans start at $299 a month, billed annually, for 1 to 20 employees.


- Every plan includes 3,000 free AI credits.


#### **Cons**


- The free trial doesn’t include the Workable Agent.


- A sourced candidate who chats uses 13 credits, $1.56 at the $600 per 5,000 bundle rate.


#### **Best for:**


Small and mid-sized companies buying an ATS and an AI agent from one vendor.


### **9. Loxo**


Loxo serves recruiting firms, with an agency-style ATS and CRM plus AI agents that search its own talent graph.


#### **Pros**


- Candidate pipelines and outreach share one record.


- Core starts at $149 per user per month, billed annually, as a new-customer offer.


#### **Cons**


- The talent graph and agents need the demo-priced Professional plan.


- Its scheduling agent is still marked coming soon.


#### **Best for:**


Recruiting agencies, from executive search to staffing.


### **10. Manatal**


Manatal is the budget pick. Its AI scores your database against a job, and its Sourcing Hub adds outside profiles.


#### **Pros**


- It’s $15 per user per month, billed annually, the lowest published ATS price here.


- There’s a 14-day free trial, and you don’t need a card.


#### **Cons**


- The Professional plan allows 10 external searches a month.


- Contact details are a separate paid pack.


#### **Best for:**


Small HR teams and agencies needing a low-cost ATS and CRM.


## **Why Look for Alternatives to Juicebox?**


### **Profile Data Can Be Out of Date**


[A Head of Human Resources](https://www.g2.com/products/juicebox-ai/reviews/juicebox-review-13496866) reports that some candidates listed in Juicebox are from prior roles and that not every candidate from their ATS appears. They say it undermines the system’s credibility, especially in front of leadership.


### **Contact Data Takes Work to Trust**


[A Senior Manager](https://www.g2.com/products/juicebox-ai/reviews/juicebox-review-13125043) has to cross-check everything on LinkedIn and finds the phone numbers only about 30% accurate. Juicebox’s pricing page is unclear on phones. Starter’s card lists email and phone, but the comparison table lists none for Starter and charges 3 credits per number on Growth.


### **ATS Sync Needs the Business Plan**


Growth costs $199 a month, or $179 billed annually, and it has no ATS sync. ATS and CRM integrations come with Business, which is custom-priced and annual only.


### **Outreach Is Email Only**


[A Talent Acquisition Specialist](https://www.g2.com/products/juicebox-ai/reviews/juicebox-review-13242805) , who calls Juicebox “unparalleled” for niche talent, says their team still relies on LinkedIn Recruiter for outreach because Juicebox’s contact options are limited to emails. Juicebox’s pricing page lists email outreach on every paid plan and no other channel.


## **How to Choose the Right Juicebox Alternative**


If your ATS works and you just need better sourcing, look at a standalone tool such as Orin or SeekOut. If you want sourcing and the ATS in one tool, look at a platform with built-in


[pipeline management](https://www.cercli.com/recruitment/pipeline-management/) , such as Cercli or Gem.


Then check three things before you book demos.


- **How you pay:** Workable and Gem charge by company size, while Pin and SeekOut charge per seat, so their costs rise with each recruiter you add. Ashby does both, by size up to 100 employees and by seat above that. Cercli quotes after a setup call.


- **Usage caps:** LinkedIn Recruiter caps InMail at 150 a month on Corporate and 30 on Lite. Manatal’s Professional plan limits you to 10 external searches a month. Workable includes 3,000 free AI credits, and a sourced candidate who chats uses 13.


- **What agents do alone:** Juicebox’s agents can auto-email or auto-shortlist. Workable’s can advance candidates automatically, with a switch to turn that off. Orin never contacts a candidate without you, and Cera recommends while you decide who advances.


Whichever you shortlist, run one real role through it before you sign.
